ingredients.name: mawa (khoya) or chocolate
ingredients.function: the modern filling; mithai-shop modak is built on mawa or chocolate rather than coconut and jaggery

ingredients.name: refined-flour or ready-mix shell
ingredients.function: the wrapper; ready shells and refined flour replace the hand-steamed rice dough, and many are fried rather than steamed

method_reconstructed: Fill a ready or refined-flour shell with mawa or chocolate.
Fry or set, rather than steam.
